textTemplates.name: thankYouLabelTextTemplate
textTemplates.text: Thank you for completing this Materiality Assessment Survey!

textTemplates.name: welcome_question_dref_tt
textTemplates.text:
This survey consists of pairs of questions corresponding to individual ESG Topics. For each topic, you will be asked to rate:
- How much of an impact your organization can have on this topic - How much of an impact this topic can have on your organization
Ratings will be provided on a scale of 1-10, with 1 signifying that the topic has the lowest potential impact, and 10 signifying that the topic has the highest potential impact.

textTemplates.name: welcome_question_lref_tt
textTemplates.text: You have been identified as a stakeholder to participate in your organization's Materiality Assessment, providing valuable input into the opportunities and risks associated with various ESG Topics for your organization. We appreciate your intentional thought and participation in this process.
